passages.text: Coincya monensis is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. Coincya monensis is native to western Europe and Morocco, but has been introduced in North America.

C. monensis subsp. cheiranthos {{au|(Vill.) Aedo, Leadlay & Muñoz Garm.}} (Wallflower Cabbage) — France, Germany & Spain
 C. monensis subsp. hispida {{au|(Cav.) Leadlay}} — central Portugal & central Spain
 C. monensis subsp. monensis (Isle of Man cabbage) — the British Isles
 C. monensis subsp. nevadensis {{au|(Willk.) Leadlay}} — southern Spain
 C. monensis subsp. orophila {{au|(Franco) Aedo, Leadlay & Muñoz Garm.}} — Morocco, Portugal & Spain
 C. monensis subsp. puberula {{au|(Pau) Leadlay}} — northern Portugal & northern Spain
 C. monensis subsp. recurvata {{au|(All.) Leadlay}} (Star mustard) — United States
